source: Ed4 C.6.5 and C.6.6, pp.C-71 to C-73; C.7.6.3, pp.C-120 to C-122; corpus-format.md 6.2 step 6
description: With the probe, the one-position limit on an errored burst does not hold MAX-SPEED above the ceiling its caps set.
note: Table (corpus-format.md 6.1) as drc-rx-errored-burst-moves-one-bulk-rung: bulk_rungs [0, 1, 3], probe_run 3. Flow as drc-rx-trial-after-clean-run: conn 1 binds SAP 5; at 1000 to 3000 a burst holding a PADDING from 0.0.1.3 to us with CAPABILITY (Ed4 1), EOT 10, records 0.0.1.3 Ed4 (C-1261); the request at 1500 queues "hello" for 0.0.1.3; at 52000 one transmission (WN 2 Long) holds the type 7 and 20 PADDING D_PDUs, all to 0.0.1.3, whose 21 EOWs are the top priority of Table C-25 (MAX-SPEED, LOW-SPEED), then SENDER-APPROACH 0xB04, then the rotation MAX-SPEED, LOW-SPEED, MAX-SEGMENT 0xAFF from its start (interp C-1260, C-1286). Earlier bursts (burst_started, bytes_received 30 ms later, burst_ended 60 ms later) hold a PADDING with EOT 0 (C-0105), or that PADDING and a type 7 to us whose data CRC fails (h = 1, e = 1: 1000 per thousand, over the 500 limit, C-0836). Codes: MAX-SPEED 0x8A0 + WN and LOW-SPEED 0x9A0 + WN at Long (C-0462, C-0469). Table positions: WN 2, 4, 6, 7 Long are 0 to 3; bulk thresholds on WN 4 Long -100, 0, 100, 150, on WN 7 Long -100, -50, 100, 400; latency on WN 2 Long -100, 100, 200, 400, on WN 4 Long -100, 100, 300, 400, on WN 7 Long -100, 0, 300, 600; smoothing weight 8, clean run 2, error limit 500 ppt, caps 2 doubling to 8. P7-9 round 4 (corpus 0.37.0, interp C-1291): a burst that is not clean moves MAX-SPEED down one position of the walk at most, but the receiver's caps still apply after that step. At 100 a clean burst on WN 7 Long, estimate 450: MAX-SPEED WN 7 Long (position 3), LOW-SPEED WN 6 Long (position 2), as drc-rx-errored-burst-moves-one-bulk-rung. At 200 a burst on WN 4 Long (a lower rung, as a short transmission would use), estimate -300, holds the PADDING and the type 7 whose data CRC fails: WN 4 Long (position 1) fails and is capped for 2 bursts, a ceiling of position 0; not clean. S = -300 on WN 4 Long (its first estimate). Bulk: T = 0 (-100 is above -300); the one-position limit gives max(0, down(2)) = 1, but 1 is above the ceiling 0, so MAX-SPEED = down(0) = 0, WN 2 Long. Latency: T = 0, LOW-SPEED WN 2 Long. The CAPABILITY burst, clean, on WN 4 Long, estimate 100: the cap counts down to 1, the ceiling stays 0; S = -300 + 200 = -100 (d = 400, q = 200); bulk target of the walk (-100, 0, 150) is 0, equal to MAX-SPEED; latency target 0 (100 is above -100): both hold at WN 2 Long. EOWs: 0x8A2, 0x9A2, 0xB04, then 0x8A2, 0x9A2, 0xAFF repeated, 21 in all; with the one-position step applied after the ceiling, or no ceiling, 0x8A4.
